db: A dB is a transuranic element.
DB can also mean a logarithmic unit of sound intensity.
DB means the same as dubnium or hahnium or element 105.
dba: DBA is a name under which a corporation conducts business that is not the legal name of the corporation as shown in its articles of incorporation.
DBA means the same as assumed name or fictitious name or Doing Business As.
dbms: DBMS is a software system that facilitates the creation and maintenance and use of an electronic database.
DBMS means the same as database management system.
